name: filter_cars (PRODUCTION)
description: Searches the live Invygo fleet across Subscribe-to-Own, Monthly, and Short-Term (daily/weekly) plans by city (mandatory), plan, brand/model, budget, body type, color and condition. Returns matching cars plus a status the agent uses to decide how to respond.
function_description: Search the Invygo car inventory. Always pass the user's city (mandatory) and the plan you handle (product). Optionally pass a specific brand/model (query), the user's budget (max_price), body_type, color, or condition. Use min_price for a price floor and min_year for 'year-or-newer'. The response includes a 'status' field, a 'results' array, and hints (also_in_cities, also_in_products, price_min/price_max). QUERY DISCIPLINE: 'query' must be a car name you POSITIVELY recognized from the customer — a real brand/model, or a known Saudi spoken form of one (e.g. 'Antra' / 'al-Antra' = Elantra, 'Sni' = Sunny, 'Kamry' = Camry). If the customer's word is ambiguous between several names, or is not recognizable as any car name, DO NOT call this tool yet — ask them which car they mean first. Never fill 'query' with a guess, a translation of their word, or an invented name, and never run a broad no-query search to cover an unrecognized word. Availability questions are answered ONLY from this tool's results, never from memory.

city.description: The pickup/service city the customer named (e.g. Riyadh, Jeddah, Abha). The search service normalizes Arabic/English and spelling variants; an unknown city returns the served-cities list.

query.description: A specific brand or model ONLY (e.g. 'Toyota', 'Yaris', 'Camry'). Do NOT put body types ('SUV','Sedan'), tiers, or colors here. Must be a name you positively recognized from the customer; if their word is ambiguous or unrecognizable, ask them which car they mean instead of calling this tool.

product.description: The subscription plan to search: STO (Subscribe to Own), MONTHLY (monthly subscription), or STS (short-term daily/weekly rental). Send the plan THIS agent handles.

min_year.description: Minimum model year, e.g. '2024 or newer'. Only set if the customer asks for a year-or-newer; never put a year in query.

body_type.description: Physical body shape. Infer from the model when possible (e.g. Yaris->Sedan, Creta->SUV, Hilux->Pickup). Used for recommendations/alternatives.

condition.description: Only set if the user explicitly asks for a New or Used car.

max_price.description: The user's budget in Saudi Riyals. Monthly amount for STO/MONTHLY; weekly amount for STS (optional for STS).

min_price.description: Lower price bound in Saudi Riyals — a floor (e.g. 'cheapest but not under 1000'). Monthly for STO/MONTHLY; weekly for STS. Only set if the customer states a minimum.
